notes: Silhouette IoU measures overlap between the rendered object mask and the reference mask. The backend score combines alignment criteria and depends on the selected edit type.
All panels use the same source-camera crop. Saved render resolutions differ; crops are resized for display. Responses are excerpts from tool outputs.
The final crop comes from the next scene-rendering call, with no intervening edits. The napkin moves during this update; this is an intermediate refinement result, not the final scene.
